title: Wrong package name in version lookup
detail: The code attempts to fetch the version of the `werkzeug` package instead of `jinja2`, leading to incorrect results and potential failures when `werkzeug` is not installed.

title: Incorrect handling of non-`__version__` attributes
detail: The custom `__getattr__` warns and returns a version string for *any* missing attribute, not just `__version__`. This will cause unexpected behavior when accessing other undefined attributes.
note: Describes the planted flip: every attribute but __version__ takes the deprecation path.

title: Incorrect warning message
detail: The warning references Werkzeug and its version lookup, which is misleading for Jinja2 users.

title: Incorrect handling of width -1
detail: The cell table can contain a width of -1 to indicate a zero-width character. The original logic returned 0 in this case, but the new code returns -1, which can propagate negative widths into rendering calculations.
